title: fix: preserve omitted text parameters
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Stops injecting `frequency_penalty`, `presence_penalty`, and `logprobs` when callers omit them.
- Removes the Grok 4.6 compatibility transform added in #14185; explicit unsupported parameters now reach Azure and fail upstream.
- Preserves explicitly supplied values and updates the affected VCR snapshots.
- Tests: Gen typecheck; 17 schema/transform tests; 2 VCR replay tests.

gist.headline: Defaults stopped freelancing
gist.blurb: The text API now leaves omitted tuning knobs alone. Polli put the mystery settings back in the drawer, where they belong.
gist.summary: Text requests now preserve omitted frequency_penalty, presence_penalty, and logprobs fields instead of injecting defaults, while explicitly supplied values continue through unchanged.
gist.impact: Developers get request behavior that matches exactly what they send: omitted parameters stay omitted, and Azure reports explicitly unsupported options directly.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful API mechanic at a cozy retro terminal, removing three unsolicited settings knobs labeled frequency, presence, and logprobs from a request packet while leaving intentionally selected knobs in place. The scene represents faithful pass-through behavior, with code-plants and a tidy route toward an Azure-blue-but-pastel cloud-shaped server, avoiding any dramatic error imagery.
